decisions.reason: The track spotlight has had its own page for two years and is core to the firm's modular system direction, so the firm's visible commitment and investment favour persistence.
The ceiling luminaire is consistently presented on its own page and fits the established range, so sunk design and dealer-display investment argue for keeping it.
The flexible spotlight was launched only in 2024 with a dedicated page, so any weak results can still be attributed to the start-up phase, which justifies continued commitment.
The multi-outlet canopy is a system component that supports the firm's announced flexible-system strategy, making it central and hard to abandon.
The low-voltage canopy extends the modular system and is newly and visibly presented, so the firm is likely to persist while the product matures.
The glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which signals weaker commitment, but they are new and fit the track system, so the firm likely keeps them for now.
